notes: Chess AI is much stronger. The game was running a weak inline engine (material-only eval, no move ordering, no transposition table) while a stronger engine (chess_worker.js: ordered alpha-beta, transposition table, iterative deepening, time-budgeted) sat in the repo unused. The game now uses the worker, which also runs off the main thread so the board no longer freezes while the AI thinks. The worker's evaluation was upgraded from material-only to material + piece-square tables, so it develops pieces, fights for the center, and keeps its king tucked instead of only trading material; auto-queen promotion was added. The inline engine is kept as an automatic fallback if the worker can't load or hangs. Client only, no server or DB change. Hard-refresh after deploy. Carries 1.1.9.4 and earlier. NOTE: poker was NOT changed this build; see the delivery note.
